_readme: Combinatorial caption parts. compose_caption() in src/captions.py picks one opener + one line + one closer per (date, vibe) — openers x lines x closers combos per vibe, so the effective caption bank is hundreds per vibe instead of 15 statics. Lines carry the vibe voice; openers/closers are shared personality. All vibes must match content/captions.json keys.
